component.name: Watercooler Manager
component.summary: Control Bluetooth laptop water coolers from the system tray

description.p: Control compatible LCT21001 and LCT22002 laptop water coolers over Bluetooth. Set fan speed, pump voltage, cooling presets and RGB lighting from a tray menu.
Requires a Bluetooth adapter, the host BlueZ service and a desktop with StatusNotifier or AppIndicator tray support.
